paths.path: ~/.config/PCSX2/inis/PCSX2.ini (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/PCSX2/inis when that variable is set and absolute; portable.ini or portable.txt next to the binary, or -portable, keeps all data under the install dir with absolute priority; -datapath <dir> relocates the data root to <dir>/PCSX2)
paths.naming: Main settings in PCSX2.ini: controller bindings in [InputSources], [Pad] (multitap ports, pointer scale) and [Pad1]..[Pad8] per pad slot; hotkeys in [Hotkeys] (the Qt build has no PCSX2_keys.ini); optional inis/secrets.ini layer; named input profiles in inputprofiles/<name>.ini selected via EmuCore/InputProfileName; per-game settings in gamesettings/
evidence: source:pcsx2-qt/QtHost.cpp InitializeConfig reads EmuFolders::Settings/PCSX2.ini and secrets.ini; ParseCommandLineOptions handles -portable and -datapath
source:pcsx2/Input/InputManager.cpp reads hotkey bindings from the "Hotkeys" settings section

paths.naming: Bindings are INI sections [InputSources], [Pad] and [Pad1]..[Pad8]; hotkeys are [Hotkeys]. Named profiles are inputprofiles/<name>.ini and per-game settings are gamesettings/; the Qt build has no PCSX2_keys.ini

paths.path: ~/.config/PCSX2/memcards/ (default [Folders] MemoryCards=memcards under the data root; user-overridable to any absolute path)
paths.naming: Default slot files Mcd001.ps2 and Mcd002.ps2 ("Mcd%03u.ps2"); multitap slots "Mcd-Multitap<port>-Slot<slot>.ps2"; slots are wired by [MemoryCards] SlotN_Filename (MultitapN_SlotM_Filename) and resolved against the memcards folder via FullpathToMcd; folder memory cards are directories whose name ends in .ps2 and contains a _pcsx2_superblock marker; image extensions .ps2/.mcr/.mcd/.bin/.mc2 are accepted (.bin/.mc2 are converted no-ECC images); per-game saves are served by serial-filtered folder cards (sioSetGameSerial -> ReIndex), PCSX2 does not auto-create serial-named card files
evidence: source:pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp Mcd[slot].Filename = FileMcd_GetDefaultName(slot); [MemoryCards] Slot%u_Filename entries; FullpathToMcd = Path::Combine(EmuFolders::MemoryCards, Mcd[slot].Filename)
source:pcsx2/SIO/Memcard/MemoryCardFolder.cpp ReIndex(enableFiltering, filter) / "FolderMcd: Indexing slot %u with filter"
source:pcsx2/SIO/Sio.cpp sioSetGameSerial passes the disc serial to mcds[port][slot].ReIndex

paths.naming: "<SERIAL> (<CRC32 as 8-digit zero-padded uppercase hex>).<slot as 2 digits>.p2s", e.g. SLUS-20228 (0C1EE0F2).01.p2s; resume state "<serial> (<crc>).resume.p2s"; backups append .backup; the savestate screenshot is embedded inside the .p2s archive rather than written alongside it
evidence: source:pcsx2/VMManager.cpp VMManager::GetSaveStateFileName format strings: "{} ({:08X}).{:02d}.p2s", "{} ({:08X}).resume.p2s", "{} ({:08X}).{:02d}.p2s.backup"; SaveState_SaveScreenshot feeds the embedded screenshot
source:pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp EmuFolders::SetDefaults Folders Savestates=sstates; filenames joined to EmuFolders::Savestates

paths.naming: Filenames are free-form; PCSX2 scans the folder and identifies dumps itself (console dumps are typically files prefixed by the console model and ending .rom0/.rom1/.nvm etc.). Required for play: the docs state "PCSX2 cannot play games without a BIOS, and no open-source alternative exists" and that BIOS files must be dumped from your own console; SHA-1 hashes for verifying dumps are maintained by the ReDump project, so do not hardcode checksums here
evidence: docs:https://pcsx2.net/docs/setup/bios (requirement, dump file extensions, ReDump SHA-1 verification)

linux.notes: AppImage builds place the data root next to the AppImage when no other root applies. Lunchbox launches PCSX2 with -datapath into a private tree (fresh inis/PCSX2.ini plus inputprofiles/) and rejects portable markers because the native source gives them priority; native memcards/sstates/bios keep their configured locations.
